goal: Expose title-engine lifecycle to Settings so a local GGUF switch shows loading versus ready, missing, or failed without blocking capture.
outcome: Settings Title engine shows a semantic spinner and an aria-live polite status while the bronze-title-model worker loads, hashes, or fails. Extractive stays idle with no spinner. Missing weights keep the existing vendor-command copy. Ready text is a catalog string. Failed reasons are safe catalog strings (missing_weights, bad_hash, timeout, unreadable) with no huge paths. Status comes from existing bronze-title stages via Tauri event title-engine-status and a title_engine_status snapshot. Focus stays on the select. Reduce Motion stops decorative spin and still updates text. ADR-019 stays Proposed. No prompt.rs edits, no runtime Hub, no new default engine, Settings only.

requirements.statement: Emit lifecycle from bronze-title stages already logged: switch scheduled, weights resolved, hash ok, model loaded, missing_weights, and load fallbacks bad_hash, timeout, unreadable. Do not change refine prompt or prompt.rs. Do not block capture. Do not put this on the event-tap thread.

Phases: idle (extractive, no file needed, no spinner); missing (existing vendored-file-missing plus vendor command, no spinner); loading or hashing (spinner plus catalog Loading {engine} or a short checking string); ready (no spinner, Ready / Loaded — will title the next capture); failed (no spinner, safe reason string, vendor command OK, no huge paths).

Wire Settings only via Tauri event title-engine-status and command title_engine_status. Live switch already reloads without relaunch; status must update during that reload. Capture never waits on load.

Spinner is semantic (progress or aria-busy on the status), visible next to Title engine. role=status or aria-live polite. Focus stays on the select when switching. prefers-reduced-motion and data-reduce-motion stop decorative spin; text still updates. No clickable div.
Every user-facing string is a locale catalog key (en, nl, fr, de, es, it). No sentence concatenation. HTML fallback matches en. Pseudo locales regenerate from en.

ADR-017 stays Accepted: no runtime network, Hugging Face Hub, or download. No Needle/Qwen as a new default. TitleABI.swift stays a compile-only stub. No llama in Swift. ADR-019 stays Proposed. Never silently accept ADR-002, ADR-009, or ADR-018.
Do not claim QUEUE-ATTACHMENTS-RUST. Do not resume bmad-loop 6a79. Do not run full-stack-app, pwa-app, or landing-page cores. Do not fight an in-flight title-prompt-summarize edit to prompt.rs.

observe/status mapping: switch scheduled → loading; weights resolved or hash ok → hashing; model loaded → ready; extractive → idle; missing_weights → missing; bad_hash, timeout, or unreadable during load → failed. Refine logs do not flip a ready engine to failed.

Settings shows loading vs ready vs missing: spinner plus Loading {engine} while loading; no spinner and ready/loaded copy when loaded; no spinner and existing vendor-command missing copy when weights are absent.
ADR-019 status remains Proposed. No WCAG, VoiceOver, or notarization claim without docs/evidence.
